resources: Update package reuses existing assets/profiles/preprocessing runtime/engine

technology_experiment: Native AddCameo; selectable data/legacy modes and local UI hardware execution breakpoint parameter modes for full technology and 21-type enhancement; native factories/events unchanged; no live purchase/netplay certification
